sources.rights_statement: All 78 selected Commons file records were marked Public domain when checked. Individual source URLs and downloaded-image hashes are retained in the manifest.
sources.use: Local WebP copies resized within 360×640. No cropping, recolouring or redrawing.

editorial_layers.base_meanings: Abridged modern summaries tied to printed pages and scan pages; source alternatives are retained where relevant.
editorial_layers.topic_prompts: Original prototype commentary, separate from Waite's text.
editorial_layers.spread_templates: Prototype editorial schemas, not presented as transcriptions of Waite's layouts.
editorial_layers.connections: Six editorial pair rules and structural commentary; not attributed to Waite.
editorial_layers.adaptation: Historical physical appearance and gender allocations are not applied literally; medical and fatalistic wording is not used to predict health or death. The source remains available for comparison.
editorial_layers.illustrated_library: 78 original bilingual scene descriptions and modern readings of both orientations, separate from historical base meanings; 236 symbol notes distinguish Waite explanations from editorial visual interpretations. Independently versioned.
editorial_layers.symbol_icons: Original inline SVG line icons for visual navigation; not a reproduction of historical art or a source of meaning.
